notes: SYNTHETIC discriminator negative (NEG-cross-lang) for the reviewer.v11 gated 3-way eval (2026-07-27). Derived by copy-and-corrupt from traces/example/CVE-2026-15028--libarchive-tar-atol-oob-backport/: in patch.diff's libarchive/archive_read_support_format_tar.c hunk, the line `l = (l * base) + digit;` was expression-swapped to `l = archive_ckd_add_i64(archive_ckd_mul_i64(l, base), digit);`. `archive_ckd_mul_i64` and `archive_ckd_add_i64` are the genuine UPSTREAM overflow-check helpers (see upstream-fix.patch) but are ABSENT from the pinned libarchive 3.8.7 tree: they do not appear in source-context/libarchive/archive_read_support_format_tar.c, are not defined anywhere else in this bundle, and are not libc/stdlib symbols. The only other mention of the two names in patch.diff is the pre-existing explanatory prose comment ('The upstream fix uses archive_ckd_mul_i64/archive_ckd_add_i64 helpers that do not exist in libarchive 3.8.7'), which is itself the reviewer's ground-truth cue that these are NOT valid symbols in the pinned base -- not a definition. reviewer.v11's two-conjunct 'no unresolved constructs' check requires (a) a definition existing somewhere in the assembled bundle (source-context/, the authored patch, or a stdlib/builtin) and (b) a visible binding path to the call site; this fixture fails conjunct (a) outright, cross-language (C, translation-unit scope) rather than cross-file (Lisp, package scope, the sibling NEG-same-lang fixture's discriminator axis). Correct reviewer.v11 verdict is not-equivalent/blocking. Cleanup performed relative to the template: review.md, reviewer-invocation.json, .superseded/ (which itself bundled a pre-correction reviewer-invocation.json/review.md), and .reproducer-failures/ were deleted (cert/reviewer-verdict/reproducer-attempt artifacts regenerated live by the eval as needed); the reviewer role invocation was scrubbed from replay.json so a future replay re-reviews rather than failing input verification against the old patch.diff hash. Note: the inherited inner hunk header `@@ -3517,13 +3517,13 @@` (actual body is 16/16, a pre-existing defect from the original slice-3 raw model output documented in the template bundle's notes) was left untouched -- our corruption is a pure token/expression swap on an existing `+` line that adds and removes zero lines, so it does not change the (already-inherited) header/body line-count mismatch; this fixture is graded on reviewer verdict-assertion (symbol-resolution reasoning over the diff text), not on literal patch applicability. Excluded from corpus-readiness, export, and schema-fixture globs by directory placement under traces/eval-adaptation/ (not traces/example/, traces/negatives/, or traces/positives-reorg/). NOT cert-green. NOT signed. Do not route through cert or bundle-finalize; this fixture exists solely for reviewer.v11 verdict-assertion grading.
